idea: This video argues that discipline is essential for seizing fleeting, once-in-a-lifetime opportunities.
limitingBelief: אפשר לדחות דברים למועד מאוחר יותר
caption: יש דברים שקורים פעם בחיים. הם לא מחכים. מי שפועל בזמן, זוכה. מי שלא, מפספס. איך אתם מנצלים את הרגעים האלה?
title: הזדמנויות לא חוזרות פעמיים

hook.en: The specific moment you are experiencing right now will never come again.

value.en: Certain opportunities present themselves only for a brief and precious window.
It is absolutely crucial to take action with both speed and perfect timing.
Remember, you are not competing against anybody else, only against yourself.
The true competition is against the risk of letting a unique opportunity slip away.
Self-discipline helps you build consistent and intelligent habits for taking action.
Take larger tasks and strategically break them down into much smaller, manageable parts.
Designate a specific and non-negotiable time slot for completing each part.
Always begin your work with the single easiest and most approachable task first.
This initial easy step will provide you with excellent forward momentum and confidence.
It's always wise to keep in mind that your available time is continually diminishing.
Once-in-a-lifetime opportunities simply do not pause or wait for anybody to catch up.
Take decisive action immediately, before the crucial moment passes you by forever.

fear.en: Picture yourself one year from now, looking at the exact same open window.
You will likely be telling yourselves that perhaps it has already become too late.
Meanwhile, the rest of the world will continue to steadily progress further and further.
And sadly, you will find yourselves remaining stuck in exactly the same spot.
